limits: The surrounding public manifest authenticates this index/helper/archive; index consistency alone is not source or native correctness.
Original commands are not rewritten. Raw references require this explicit per-run mapping after deduplication.
Private compiled archives remain available locally by original identities, but their bytes are not distributed.

Raw personal-path data is never redacted into apparent originals; none of948command streams needed quarantine. Eight original launcher JSON records remain private with exact hashes and labelled projections.
